components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is used to derive the owner's salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat form); when structured address fields are
            supplied it is derived instead. On output it is the composed, normalized
            address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (e.g. street number and
            name). When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'
            input and is normalized the same way (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case,
            expand common street-type abbreviations).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            suite). When supplied it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
            The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid email address; the stored value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Serialized as an ISO date
            'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner. When present it is used
            to derive the owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
            Serialized as an ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the city's region: NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. When supplied it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, declares the owner a household member so it is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate even when another owner has the same Soundex last name and
            postcode. Duplicate rejection (409) is keyed on the full identity key
            (telephone, email, Soundex last name), which this flag does not affect. The
            householdId is always derived from the last name and postcode regardless of
            this flag. A request-only flag; it is not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                using the owner's id. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title followed by a single space and the
                last name, or just the last name when no title is present. Derived
                from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, or
                UNKNOWN when the postcode is absent or in no known range); FY is the
                2-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the registration date; HASH8
                is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                telephone concatenated with the last name; and CHK is a single Luhn
                check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned
                at creation time and de-duplicated by appending '-<n>' on collision.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW26A1B2C3D45'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same
                household (same last name and postcode). Deterministic: the first 12
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name,
                a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner with the same last
                name and postcode computes the same value automatically. Null when
                the owner has no postcode (and so belongs to no household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name
                (case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the 2-digit FY
                segment of the memberId (the fiscal year, starting 1 July, of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate). Read off the memberId so it
                cannot drift from the identifier.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: a running score starting at 0 that
                gains 2 when an email address is present, 1 when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2 when it belongs to a household of
                3 or more members, and 3 for tenure of more than one elapsed fiscal
                year (starting 1 July). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level: a number from 1 to 4 derived by
                banding membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5
                and 4 for 6 or more. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION component of the owner's region-and-hash identity: the
                leading REGION segment of the memberId, i.e. the region derived from
                the postcode (2000-2099->NSW, 3000-3099->VIC, 4000-4099->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the postcode is absent or in no known range. Derived
                from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Null when the
                region is not one of these (e.g. 'UNKNOWN'). Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate computed against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Null when birthDate is absent.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The lower-case hex SHA-256 of normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail +
                '|' + soundex(lastName), where the telephone is E.164, the email is
                lower-cased (empty when absent) and the last name is reduced to its
                Soundex code. This single key is the identity used for duplicate
                detection: a new owner is rejected with 409 when its key matches an
                existing non-deleted owner's. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'a3f5c8d2e1b4079f6c8a2d4e0b1f3a5c7d9e2b4f6a8c0d2e4f6a8b0c2d4e6f80'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164. Derived from
                the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created on the same effective business day;
                otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, its city already held
                between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50);
                otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode while
                having a different telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation
                time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of (same last name and postcode, different telephone), or
                null when it is not a possible duplicate. Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining the
                record. Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants a closer look: it is a possible
                duplicate, or its email domain is disposable-adjacent (a neighbour
                of the disposable-domain blocklist, such as a different TLD or a
                subdomain), or its city is over soft capacity (the approaching-limit
                capacityWarning); otherwise false. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'

        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is used to derive the owner's salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat form); when structured address fields are
            supplied it is derived instead. On output it is the composed, normalized
            address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (e.g. street number and
            name). When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'
            input and is normalized the same way (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case,
            expand common street-type abbreviations).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            suite). When supplied it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
            The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid email address; the stored value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Serialized as an ISO date
            'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner. When present it is used
            to derive the owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
            Serialized as an ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the city's region: NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. When supplied it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, declares the owner a household member so it is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate even when another owner has the same Soundex last name and
            postcode. Duplicate rejection (409) is keyed on the full identity key
            (telephone, email, Soundex last name), which this flag does not affect. The
            householdId is always derived from the last name and postcode regardless of
            this flag. A request-only flag; it is not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true

        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object

              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.

              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title followed by a single space and the
                last name, or just the last name when no title is present. Derived
                from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner API representation. Always 2 for the
                version-2 identity release, which groups the owner's identifiers
                under the nested 'identity' object.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's version-2 identifiers (memberId, identityKey and
                householdId), grouped under this nested object.
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'

            namesakeCount:

              description: >-

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0

                business-day-adjusted registrationDate). Read off the memberId so it
                cannot drift from the identifier.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: a running score starting at 0 that
                gains 2 when an email address is present, 1 when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2 when it belongs to a household of
                3 or more members, and 3 for tenure of more than one elapsed fiscal
                year (starting 1 July). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-

                banding membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5
                and 4 for 6 or more. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment

                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived from the owner's own fields.

              enum:

                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality

                The REGION component of the owner's region-and-hash identity: the
                leading REGION segment of the memberId, i.e. the region derived from

              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true

                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,

                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from the owner's

          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
            REGION is the version-2 region code derived from the postcode (the fixed
            'V2' tag followed by NSW/VIC/QLD, or 'V2UNKNOWN' when the postcode is absent
            or in no known range, e.g. 'V2NSW'); FY is the 2-digit fiscal year (starting
            1 July) of the registration date; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
            characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
            last name; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation time and de-duplicated by
            appending '-<n>' on collision.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW26A1B2C3D45'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The lower-case hex SHA-256 of 'V2' + '|' + normalizedTelephone + '|' +
            lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName), where the leading 'V2' is the
            version-2 identity tag, the telephone is E.164, the email is lower-cased
            (empty when absent) and the last name is reduced to its Soundex code. This
            single key is the identity used for duplicate detection: a new owner is
            rejected with 409 when its key matches an existing non-deleted owner's.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is used to derive the owner's salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat form); when structured address fields are
            supplied it is derived instead. On output it is the composed, normalized
            address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (e.g. street number and
            name). When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'
            input and is normalized the same way (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case,
            expand common street-type abbreviations).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2

            suite). When supplied it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
            The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid email address; the stored value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Serialized as an ISO date
            'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner. When present it is used
            to derive the owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
            Serialized as an ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the city's region: NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. When supplied it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'

          title: Shares household
          description: >-

            possible duplicate even when another owner has the same Soundex last name and
            postcode. Duplicate rejection (409) is keyed on the full identity key
            (telephone, email, Soundex last name), which this flag does not affect. The
            householdId is always derived from the last name and postcode regardless of
            this flag. A request-only flag; it is not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
